messages:
Maya (EventOps): Short ops thread to confirm webinar logistics for next Thu. Need registration page, Zoom webinar settings, recording fallback, and post-event routing. I will produce.

Raj (Growth): Recommend HubSpot form so leads flow direct to CRM. Capture utm parameters and a field for partner_code.

Sam (Prod Marketing): Landing should include one-line benchmark stat and a CTA to book a demo. Gate slides by email capture.

Alice (Content): I'll draft confirmation + 24h, 1h, and 10m reminders. Follow-up: same-day recording + slides + transcript, then highlights email 3 days later.

Diego (Sales Ops): Routing rules: partner_code -> partner SDR; else if company_size >= 50 -> AE; else SDR. Will set HubSpot workflow and Slack notify for AE-assigned leads.

Maya (EventOps): Zoom: use Webinar license, enable practice session, Q&A, polling. Enable cloud recording + auto-transcribe. ZoomBot: "Webinar created: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (ID: 123 456 789)"

Sam (Prod Marketing): Ask presenters to record local backup. We'll export cloud recording and local, produce a short clip for social.

Raj (Growth): UTM scheme: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=optimize_launch. Add hidden fields on form.

Diego (Sales Ops): Zapier example: New HubSpot submission -> filter (company_size >=50 OR intent_score >=70) -> assign AE -> create task.

Alice (Content): Two follow-up variants: "Recording + demo" and "Recording + whitepaper" to A/B test subject lines.

Maya (EventOps): Rehearsal: Wed 30min tech run. I'll send panelist links and rehearsal invite. Disable attendee file sharing and restrict recording access to marketing@redwood.com.

Sam (Prod Marketing): I'll upload slides and local recording immediately after. Also include a short transcript cleanup step before publish.

Maya (EventOps): Quick checklist recap: HubSpot landing (Raj/Alice), Zoom + recording (Maya), Workflows & routing (Diego), Slides + local record (Sam), Follow-up copy (Alice). Any blockers?

Raj (Growth): None. I'll build the form and include partner_code/utm hidden fields.

Diego (Sales Ops): I'll draft the HubSpot workflow and Zapier filter today.

ZoomBot: "Cloud recording enabled. Auto-transcription ON. Recording access: hosts + marketing@redwood.com."
